ai.title: Etsy posts strong second quarter, then cuts 12% of workforce; CEO Kruti Patel Goyal says layoffs aren't driven by AI or cost-cutting
ai.description: Etsy is reducing its global workforce by approximately twelve percent. This significant restructuring impacts around two hundred twenty employees, primarily in Product and Engineering. The company's CEO stated these decisions were not driven by cost-cutting or artificial intelligence. This move follows strong second-quarter financial results and a raised full-year guidance. Affected employees will receive comprehensive severance packages and healthcare support.
ai.title_cn: Etsy第二季度业绩强劲，随后裁员12%;首席执行官Kruti Patel Goyal表示裁员并非由人工智能或成本削减推动
ai.description_cn: Etsy正在将其全球员工人数减少约12%。这次重大重组影响了大约220名员工，主要是产品和工程部门。该公司首席执行官表示，这些决定不是由成本削减或人工智能推动的。此举是在第二季度财务业绩强劲且全年指引上调之后采取的。受影响的员工将获得全面的遣散费和医疗保健支持。

ai.title: DeepSeek invests $20.8 million in Unitree's Shanghai IPO
ai.description: Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek has invested 140.8 ‌million yuan ($20.8 million) in robot maker Unitree and agreed to jointly develop AI models for humanoid machines, according to a stock-exchange filing.
